why_this_exists: Eleven route changes and 47 laps all re-aimed WHERE the offer is sold. Not one of them changed what the ABUNDANT pool is spent on, and nobody had ever counted. This file is that count, and scripts/lane-allocation.mjs is the reader — because a share written where nothing reads it is the exact defect this session has now hit five times.
the_measurement_that_elected_route_5: 22 completed lane tasks. ONE produced the thing being sold (2026-08-09.q, the free demo). Two produced storefront copy. Two were reviews of our own offer. Seventeen were research about the outside world. 4.5% payload. Meanwhile route 4 names its own prerequisite as 'an artifact someone who did not make it would pay for' — and the only pool that has ever produced an artifact was spending 95% of itself on research.

the_kinds_and_why_there_are_four.payload: The answer contains the thing a buyer would receive, whole and usable. This is the only kind that can satisfy route 4's prerequisite, and it is what the floor below counts.
the_kinds_and_why_there_are_four.surface: Copy, cover text, listing prose. A real deliverable, but it wraps the offer rather than being it. Kept separate on purpose: folding it into payload would have made the share read 13.6% and hidden the finding.
the_kinds_and_why_there_are_four.measurement: A reading about our own offer — a stranger round, a verdict. Returns knowledge about the thing, not the thing.
the_kinds_and_why_there_are_four.research: A reading about the outside world — competitors, prices, venues, real sellers.

how_a_task_is_classified: From the `produces:` field in its codex/INBOX.md yaml header. Tasks completed before that field existed are classified once, by hand, in `legacy` below, with the evidence line each classification rests on. New tasks MUST declare it: scripts/lane-allocation.mjs goes red on a live task that does not, so the hand-classification can never grow.

floor.why_a_queued_task_counts: The floor exists to catch the lane DRIFTING BACK to research-only, not to punish the gap while a build is in flight. A live task declaring produces: payload is the loop doing the right thing and must read as green, or the check would be red during exactly the behaviour it wants.
floor.why_8: The last 8 completed tasks (2026-08-09.r through 2026-08-10.f) contain ZERO payload. A window that did not already fire on the record that motivated it would be a floor set to whatever we happen to be doing.
floor.why_route_scoped: If a later lap elects a route where research genuinely is the binding term, this floor should stop binding rather than be deleted. A check that outlives its reason is the kind nobody can safely turn off.

what_this_file_must_not_become: A list of everything the lane has ever done. It is a SHARE. If a future lap finds itself appending rows to make the number look better, the number has stopped measuring anything. The legacy block is closed: it covers the 22 tasks that predate the `produces:` field and it must never gain a 23rd row.
legacy_classified_by: the lap that elected route 5, reading the first four lines of each codex/outbox/*.md
